entities.summary: Tom Segev is an Israeli historian, author and journalist. He is associated with Israel's New Historians, a group critical of many of the country's traditional narratives. Tom Segev was a journalists & chroniclers from Jerusalem (b. 1945-03-01, Jerusalem). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
